title: MPTokenIssuance
key_points: The MPTokenIssuance ledger entry type allows issuing new tokens.
It requires a secret (seed) to be specified and a flags parameter.
The token issuance transaction specifies the account to issue the tokens to.
Issued tokens are added to the destination account's balance.
limitations: Does not cover all possible use cases or variations of the feature.
asserts: MPTokenIssuance is a ledger entry type used for issuing new tokens by specifying a destination account and using a secret.
scope: Describes how to issue new tokens using the MPTokenIssuance entry type in the XRP Ledger protocol.
